body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary Poison Condition and one Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn. Gain +1 Composure against pain-based effects during that time.

surges.html: Extend both suppressions through the end of your next turn.
Reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Adaptation - Chimera
rider.html: Assume Partition (upkeep 1): while you maintain this Adaptation, suppress the Composure penalty from one ordinary pain Condition and ignore the penalty from Unstable. Neither Condition is removed.
